name: jfdi-agents
description: An opinionated agent team for Claude Code that autonomously designs and builds software. The Product Owner and Architect scope the system, then the Architect mints a small set of tailored per-layer developer agents (backend, frontend, middleware, shared, etc.) into the project. The team walks the stack sequentially to build a walking skeleton, then works in parallel — each developer owning its own folder — to refine the product against a high-level acceptance list. Deliberately lightweight on ceremony: no formal specs, no Gherkin, no roadmap — just a vision, a folder map, and agents that build.
